summarize_model_config: summarize the ResNetV1d-50 ImageClassifier model configuration dictionary
review_model_config: review the ResNetV1d backbone and LinearClsHead settings in the model config
build_model_from_config: build an ImageClassifier using the ResNetV1d-50 backbone config with GlobalAveragePooling neck
refactor_model_config: refactor the model config to change the ResNetV1d depth or num_classes
test_model_config: test the ResNetV1d-50 model config by instantiating the ImageClassifier with the given dict
